pages.title: Aberythe Sword
pages.text: Forged from the shimmering Aberythe gem, this blade is a reliable companion for your first steps into the dark. It deals 8 attack damage with an attack speed of 1.8 and holds up for 1750 uses. Simple, sharp and dependable, it will serve you well until you find rarer treasures.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: Two Aberythe Gems on top of a stick.
